<!-- pr-reviewer: 41af653fcea989a7ca9e0f0ce495efa79be5a349 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is the first review of this PR. It has no blocking finding.

Tier: documentation only (`site/content/guide/**` and one `docs/decisions/` file). The PR does not change posted G-code, a gouge or collision check, stock simulation, geometry or `crates/ui`. Thus it is not a SAFETY-tier review, and it needs no mutation and no screenshots.

## What looks good

I compared each new statement with the code on `upstream/main` `02d05bc1c`.

- #3611 (`cli.md`): the title is `(read-only)` (`crates/ui/src/state.rs:4849`). A save over the opened file is refused (`crates/ui/src/state_read_only.rs:44`).
- #3547 (`first-run.md`): the interval is 24 hours (`crates/app/src/update_check.rs:22`). The notice text is `Update available: vX.Y.Z` and a click opens the release notes (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/update_notice.rs:62`). The toggle is `Check for updates` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/settings_drop.rs:16`).
- #3550 (`operations-3d.md`): the row is `Steep flanks` with `Waterlines` and `Leave uncut` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill3d_page.rs:352`). The 45 degree limit, the warning and the refusal agree with `crates/motion/src/finishing3d/raster.rs:308` and `:354`. Waterline, Blend and Morph refuse `waterlines: false` (`rings.rs:549`, `raster.rs:266`, `morph.rs:176`).
- #3059 (`operations-2d.md`): the wall requirement and the Boundary refusal agree with `crates/motion/src/machining2d/chamfer.rs:222` and `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:365`.
- #3219 (`operations-edm.md`): the 10 mm stock, the 0.25 mm wire and the full 3 mm hole agree with `crates/app/src/operation/agie_inspection.rs:112`, `:121` and `:170`. The two UI labels agree with `agie_inspection.rs:30` and `op_page.rs:348` in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/`. The link target `### Agie nominal inspection` is at `site/content/guide/automate/mcp.md:128`.
- #3061 (`units-and-coordinates.md`): the layers and the `units` rule agree with the `import_svg` description (`crates/app/src/mcp/svg_tools.rs:17`).
- #3630 (`continuous-4-axis.md`): the kernel description agrees with `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/rotary_flow.rs:1`. No file in `crates/app/src` or `crates/ui/src` names Rotary Flow, so "not offered yet" is correct. The decision file records this.
- #3458 (`operations-2d.md`): the text agrees with the merged PR #3458 (profile, chains or layer; arcs kept; a lift between strokes; the checks can hold the post).
- Laws: the commit subject is conventional. The body has `Changelog: none`, "Goldens moved: no program files changed" and `Refs #3909` (partial work; the issue stays open). The decision file has the `## #N - <title>` form. No process file, snapshot PNG, golden or recorded program changes.

## Results merged with main

Built and tested locally. The PR head is one commit on `upstream/main` `02d05bc1c`, so the trial merge is the PR head.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: "nothing in crates/ changed: no tests to run".
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests` on the PR head: 104 tests, 1 failure and 8 errors.
- The same command on bare `upstream/main` `02d05bc1c`: 104 tests, the same 1 failure and the same 8 errors. This PR adds no red test.
  - `test_guide_icons.test_component_static_icons_and_license_match_app`: failure on main (license notice mismatch). #3673 tracks the red `test_guide_icons`.
  - `test_first_4axis_part` and `test_first_continuous_4axis_part`, `test_each_bold_ui_label_is_a_string_in_its_source` (`New tool…`): error on main. I found no issue that tracks it; #3764 is the related issue.
  - `test_search_query` (3 tests, 6 errors): this host has no `node`. This is an environment error, the same on main. The author's run had 101 of 104 pass, which agrees with these 3 tests green where `node` is installed.
- The navigation and link tests (`test_guide_navigation`) passed.
- `zola --root site build`: not run. This host refused the command. I checked the one new internal link by reading (see above). The author reports that the build passed.
- Clippy and the Rust suites: not run, because no Rust file changes.

## Extra suites run

None is owed. The diff changes no `testdata/`, fixture, golden or importer file. Heavy lanes: not reached by this diff.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

1. `site/content/guide/operations/operations-edm.md:321`: the desktop form shows only a hint until the AGIECUT CLASSIC 2S machine is mounted on the setup (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/agie_inspection.rs:36`). The linked procedure says this. One sentence here can say it too.
2. `site/content/guide/operations/operations-2d.md:713`: "on the air side" is not exact. The tool goes down in the air one chamfer width off the first end of the run, and it leaves past the other end (`chamfer.rs:168`).
3. `site/content/guide/automate/cli.md:46` and `site/content/guide/reference/units-and-coordinates.md:78`: each line is longer than the wrap width of the file. The rendered page is the same.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

left for the maintainer: no counted pr-reviewer marker at head 41af653fcea989a7ca9e0f0ce495efa79be5a349 from anyone other than the author (mkinney); the author marker does not count. A clean review by an agent that did not write this change is owed. It is a docs-only PR, but the review law still applies.
